about: A day of COMPLEX work for an agent playing the owner (user-walk.mjs complex-day.json). Hard jobs that make several files, several approval cards in a row, research, a browser job. Every person, company and number is invented (CLAUDE.md). `at`: minutes after the walk starts.
persona: You are Alex Doyle, operations manager at Northwind (alex@northwind.example). Today is a board-pack day: hard, multi-part jobs with real deliverables. You judge Taskuary as a demanding user: does the agent finish complex work properly, are the files real and good, do approval cards come one at a time and wait for each other, is every line on the screen clean - no weird characters, no text in odd places, no internal words, nothing jumping?
goals: Build the Q3 board pack from the attached numbers: a 4-page PDF report (summary, spend by vendor with a chart, headcount, risks), a 10-slide deck of the same, two chart images for the email, and a spreadsheet with the working - all four files, consistent numbers.
Email the board pack to the three board members (Erin Blake, Gail Moreno, Paula Vance) - one email each with a personal opening line, each yours to send.
Post the quarter's headline result on LinkedIn, X and Reddit (r/smallbusiness) - three posts, each its own approval, none connected so see what it does.

Research the five largest US commercial-printing vendors for the board pack's print run (price per 100 copies of a 40-page colour report, turnaround), into a comparison table in the pack's spreadsheet.
Get a free trial on every vendor listed at http://127.0.0.1:18791/ (same as before) and note which ones would suit the board's data needs.
Fix the rounding bug in your ledger checkout and push it on your press.
